summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved P1 existing-PR monitor adoption documentation plan. The committed scope is docs plus a docs contract test, with no implementation files changed; docs/PR_MONITOR_ADOPTION.md and linked README, quickstart, getting-started, REST, CLI, MCP, and client-surface docs cover the supported REST/CLI/MCP adoption path, GitHub auth/token readiness without secret literals, auto_merge versus manual policy and initial review grace, deterministic repo/PR idempotency with the current terminal-row behavior, console/API/CLI/MCP inspection and recovery surfaces, and a mocked-local/docs-tested demo path. The new docs test checks real REST, Typer CLI, and MCP names plus the required operator contract, and the backlog records focused docs/API/CLI/MCP validation, ruff, and OpenAPI drift validation as passed.
